demos.name: Burn With Me Demo
demos.shortDescription: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

demos.name: Teaching Gender-Affirming Care
demos.shortDescription: An educational visual training simulation that follows transgender and gender-diverse patients at a primary care clinic. Step into the role of a new provider as you prescribe and optimize hormone therapy, counsel patients around surgical affirmation, navigate care considerations for adolescents

demos.name: 868-BACK
demos.shortDescription: 868-BACK is a computer-hacking strategy roguelike game where your mission is to dismantle capitalism one server at a time! Use hacking powers to fight enemies, steal the servers' data, and face increasingly nasty situations before being disconnected (again!) by the richest corporations on earth.

demos.name: Astra's Garden
demos.shortDescription: Long ago, in a magical town filled with witches... There was one particular witch, Astragalus, who opened an apothecary. Grow some plants to help heal your customers and ease whatever ails them in this relaxing little idle game.

demos.name: Thousands of Chroma Demo
demos.shortDescription: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

demos.name: Good Catch! Demo
demos.shortDescription: Good Catch! is a relaxing fishing game about cozy fishing spots, rare catches, small quests and friendly characters you unlock along the way.

demos.name: Facettes
demos.shortDescription: Explore the story of Facettes as you play as a woman discovering her homosexuality and overcoming her identity crisis. This self-questioning protagonist channels her introspection in her RPG inspired fantasy world: Facettes.

demos.name: Robosynthesis
demos.shortDescription: A solar-powered robot awakens in an abandoned data center. — In this short 3D platformer, your movement, health, and ammo all use precious solar energy. Plan your actions carefully to seek freedom, as every step may be your last.

demos.name: SALVO
demos.shortDescription: A tactical immersive sim. You are underground with nothing but missiles. Design ballistic weapons, hunt billion-dollar radars with 20,000-dollar drones, flood the enemy with cruise missiles, or reach hypersonic technology. Welcome to asymmetric war.

demos.name: Nursing Simulator—Code Ube
demos.shortDescription: When things aren't as they seem, nobody stands against fate but one nurse. Play as Karen—a nurse who saves lives and kicks butt! Complete tasks, give meds, and document assessments. But when night comes, beware of those who try to steer you away from what's right.

demos.name: Rogue Maze Demo
demos.shortDescription: Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

demos.name: Cherry on Top Demo
demos.shortDescription: Chaos, coins, and cake! The free demo for Cherry on Top!

demos.name: Physician Simulator Demo
demos.shortDescription: A Papers, Please-style medical bureaucracy sim. You're a fresh graduate assigned to a small-town clinic. Diagnose patients, spot fake referrals, refuse pushy pensioners. Every decision shapes your reputation. Five days, twenty-five lessons in saying "no".

demos.name: Prophet Margin Demo
demos.shortDescription: Build thriving settlements. Weave intricate trade routes. Optimize complex supply chains to earn divine boons. Master a meditative City Builder where board-game logic meets deep Resource Management. A relaxing, 'real-time with pause' strategy puzzle where every decision is yours to undo.

demos.name: SCAD
demos.shortDescription: SCAD is an action‑packed, post‑apocalyptic roguelite where you pilot a customizable hovercraft. Fight relentless zombie hordes, craft and upgrade powerful weapons, and gear up for the future expeditions.

demos.name: Mining Grounds
demos.shortDescription: A clicker where every click matters. Build chains, break limits, and automate everything. Place characters to trigger powerful combos, unlock upgrades, and scale your clicks to extreme levels. No rush. Just satisfying progression and smart strategy.

demos.name: Attack of the Astrals Demo
demos.shortDescription: Turn-based strategy roguelike where every battle is a tactical puzzle. Each move of your champion trio unleashes an attack and swaps tiles with other units. Combine skills, spells and summons to defeat a cosmic army that grows stronger as you do.

demos.name: Polly's Puzzle Box Demo
demos.shortDescription: As a small flea, explore a mysterious puzzle box filled with shapes and secrets. Gather strange items with hidden abilities, and unravel a trail of clues as you attempt to escape.

demos.name: Mistaken
demos.shortDescription: The world is lost to eldritch mist. No heroes, no grand purpose—only survival. Build, fight, and carve your path through treacherous lands where the remnants of humanity and horrors beyond reason now roam. Survive… or be Mistaken.

demos.name: Cardburners
demos.shortDescription: CardBurners is a chaotic fast-paced, solo or online versus card game. You must play your cards quickly before they burn in your hand! Mix and match completely different sets of cards and rules to create unique action packed games.

demos.name: Ritualis: Summoner Simulator
demos.shortDescription: An ancient town needs your magic of summoning. Summon bizarre items and creatures to fulfill townsfolk requests. Earn coins and uncover the strange secrets of the locals. Oh, and try to cure your sudden amnesia. It might just save your life!

demos.name: What's the Password?
demos.shortDescription: "What's the Password?" is a minimalistic puzzle game where you decode 4-digit passwords. Featuring over 100 puzzles!

demos.name: Mimic Meadows Demo
demos.shortDescription: A puzzle game about transforming into animals by mimicking their movement. Discover creative ways to wield this power while solving mind-bending puzzles. And attempt to unearth the many secrets of the meadows.

demos.name: Heavy Duty Inc. Demo
demos.shortDescription: Lead three space mechanics through tense turn‑based tactical battles to save a collapsing space station. Work the shifts solo (for now), picking new gear between missions to keep your crew patched up and pushing on!

demos.name: FROGBLOCK
demos.shortDescription: Hop into 100+ beautiful Perspective-Block-Puzzle levels as a tiny Frog! Change your perspective to find illusory paths, and create your own paths by moving Frogblocks around. Explore biomes and discover new mechanics while listening to a rich and calming original soundtrack!

demos.name: Scale the Depths
demos.shortDescription: Fish, scale, sell, repeat. Scale the Depths is a casual fishing game built around this simple but satisfying loop. Feed hungry customers, upgrade your gear, and uncover the many secrets hidden beneath the surface.

demos.name: Make It a Million
demos.shortDescription: The ultimate number-placement puzzle! Master the unique Rock-Paper-Scissors stacking system, chain massive combos, and race to 1,000,000 points

demos.name: Dig n Fight Demo
demos.shortDescription: Dig n Fight is a roguelite idle game with backpack management. Equip yourself with treasures, skills, and runes to defeat your foes and bring back all the loot.

demos.name: Easy Pose
demos.shortDescription: Easy Pose is a human body pose app for people who draw or is learning to draw.

demos.name: Rabbit Claw Party Demo
demos.shortDescription: Rabbit Claw Party Demo is a claw-machine scoring game where lively rabbits move in their own ways. Time your grabs, clear demo stages, complete tasks to collect stickers, decorate your photo wall, and enjoy local two-player fun.

demos.name: Tyrania Enforcers - Visual Novel Demo
demos.shortDescription: Faced with evil... would you pull the trigger? Tyrania Enforcers is a story-driven visual novel exploring morality, duty, and the cost of enforcing order in a world on the brink of conflict.

demos.name: Touhou Yukkuri Mountain
demos.shortDescription: 3D Puzzle: Take It Easy!!! Touhou Project characters are here in their ""Yukkuri"" forms! Stack up the ""Yukkuri"" and create your very own ""Yukkuri Mountain""!

demos.name: Selfie Worm Demo
demos.shortDescription: Selfie Worm is a cozy adventure blending squishy 2D physics with photography. Control an elastic worm through a colorless world, capturing selfies to restore vibrancy and uncover a heartwarming narrative. Featuring a built-in "Anti-Boss Mode" and Focus Timer, it turns work breaks into healing times.

demos.name: A Game About Flipping Cards Demo
demos.shortDescription: It's all in the title. A Game About Flipping Cards is an incremental game where you flip cards to make money to buy more cards and upgrades to make more money to buy more upgrades to make more money.

demos.name: RPG Soundboard
demos.shortDescription: RPG Soundboard is an audio companion for tabletop RPG game masters, featuring a user interface designed for easier, live playback. Load your own music and sound effects, organize them across multiple soundboards and playlists, and increase the immersion of your table.

demos.name: Tale of Chak Chak
demos.shortDescription: Help Chak Chak on a heartwarming journey of friendship, self-discovery, and finding true happiness. Play mindfulness-inspired mini-games, grow her aura, and explore a charming cozy world filled with warmth, joy, and meaningful moments.

demos.name: Factomancer Demo
demos.shortDescription: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

demos.name: Cosmo Cargo Demo
demos.shortDescription: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelike PvE game in which you fight to maintain chaos in the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

demos.name: LavaLoop Demo
demos.shortDescription: An explosive musical show set in a hand-drawn retro-futuristic universe. From shoot’em up to rhythm game, take on the role of three punk musicians, confronting a mad queen and her planet-killing machine. Discover a surprising gameplay blending arcade, music and comics!

demos.name: Chomp Garden Demo
demos.shortDescription: A puzzle game about guiding plants with light. Venture into a garden full of strange plants, solve puzzles, and find your pup.

demos.name: Worlds Upon The Wind Demo
demos.shortDescription: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

demos.name: Hop Hop! Donut
demos.shortDescription: Strap on balloons and soar through the skies as Donut the corgi in this adorable 2D platformer! Battle evil cats, dodge deadly obstacles, and rescue your kidnapped owner in a whimsical adventure inspired by Balloon Fight.

demos.name: Nocturne for Cyl-Hestia
demos.shortDescription: Play as a memorialist and investigate a dystopian city in this 3D adventure game. Collect memories, unlock visions, hack encrypted data, and expose the truth in the face of a regime that manipulates memory.

demos.name: Beat Vector Demo
demos.shortDescription: A 360° Rhythm Game where smashing beats makes the world explode with effects. Transform every track into a massive light show!

demos.name: Birdwatching Notebook
demos.shortDescription: Turn your balcony into your very own birdwatching spot, and await the arrival of new avian friends! Enjoy a cozy idle game — place a tiny postcard on the corner of your screen, keeping you company with pleasant scenes and visiting birds. Oh, and don't forget your camera!

demos.name: Rose and Locket
demos.shortDescription: To save her daughter's soul, outlaw gunslinger Rose must journey into the Underwest - the wild west's mysterious underworld - and hunt the Deadly Sins. Experience this action-adventure platformer that blurs the line between graphic novel and game experience.

demos.name: Time of the Lilies
demos.shortDescription: A spy thriller featuring an escaped State Security agent navigating a conspiracy involving federal police, foreign agitators, and a familiar face from years past.

demos.name: Mexican Train Demo
demos.shortDescription: Mexican Train brings the classic game of Mexican Train Dominoes to 3D, supporting up to 7 players per online multiplayer session, or play solo and compete against up to 6 CPU players.

demos.name: Planet No More Demo
demos.shortDescription: Planet No More is an arcade-incremental game where you build a fleet to dynamically shatter celestials. With every weapon and fleet upgrade, you'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

demos.name: 7 Days Before the End
demos.shortDescription: 一个普通的早晨，五个大学生踏入同一间教室，却在陌生的空间醒来。纸条上写着： “在七天内找到真相，否则这里就会崩塌。”——你将如何度过这七天？

demos.name: Mystery Phantoms: Ghostly Secrets Collector's Edition
demos.shortDescription: Investigate haunted locations, find hidden objects, solve eerie puzzles, and uncover ghostly secrets as reality begins to crack around you.

demos.name: Super Sub: World Cup Demo
demos.shortDescription: Win the world cup through clever clicks, useful upgrades, silly own goals, and bending the rules. An active twist on incremental games that strips football down to just its beautiful beating heart: kick balls hard, score goals, earn money.

demos.name: Kanji Cats
demos.shortDescription: Tired of Anki or Duolingo? Always get confused by look-alike kanji or mix up on/kun readings? Kanji Cats is an edutainment game that teaches Japanese through cat-and-sushi-themed mini-games. Match, type, and sort kanji while learning in a cozy pixel-art sushi bar with cats!

demos.name: Deep Corp
demos.shortDescription: Dig mines, extract resources, and produce goods to restore order to the state. Become a successful businessman and an effective state governor in the late Wild West era!

demos.name: Tower of Babel: Survivors of Chaos
demos.shortDescription: Battle hordes of monsters, acquire new skills, and upgrade your abilities. Customize your build with hundreds of item combinations and reach the top to fulfill your deepest desires. Conquer the tower in this thrilling roguelite hack and slash survivors game!

demos.name: Apoikia Demo
demos.shortDescription: Apoikia is a city-building and economic simulation where you grow a settlement into a thriving hub by mastering supply chains, regional markets, and legal policy, with upcoming combat and free-market investment systems.

demos.name: Roommate Lover: Love in Progress
demos.shortDescription: With a mature and sophisticated female CEO, a stunningly beautiful news anchor, a college sweetheart, and the girl next door all entering her life, what will be the final outcome of this battle for love?

demos.name: Teamfight Manager 2
demos.shortDescription: Teamfight Manager is back with more detailed tactics, management, and a new MOBA-style gameplay. Take charge of a virtual e-sports team, build the ultimate roster, and become the greatest manager!

demos.name: TORR Demo
demos.shortDescription: A retro turn-based exploration game reminiscent of 80s RPGS! Explore the land of TORR by fighting daemons, solving puzzles, and uncovering the origins of the cloud sea that separates the world from the land below...

demos.name: DYLIA Demo
demos.shortDescription: DYLIA is a 2D adventure game with a strong emphasis on exploration and narrative. This is a journey of a mysterious girl and a mysterious duck. As the game progresses, you will learn their true identities and the truth of the world.

demos.name: Wild Horse Racing
demos.shortDescription: Wild Horse Racing is a fast-paced arcade horse racing game where timing is everything! Master the rhythm-based controls, leap over big jumps, and race through hand-crafted tracks around the world. Climb the leagues, manage your horse, and gallop from bronze to gold!

demos.name: EMUUROM
demos.shortDescription: A creature-scanning metroidvania. Explore an ancient paradise before it's lost forever. Study the EMUUROM creatures, document your findings in the EMUUDEX, and use what you learn to unlock new paths.

demos.name: Enter the Chronosphere
demos.shortDescription: Everything moves when you do in Enter the Chronosphere, the turn-based bullet hell roguelike. Each chronosphere is procedurally generated with defenders and biomes from the worlds it has consumed. Break in, find exotic weaponry and gadgets, outsmart hostile aliens, and fight your way to the core.

demos.name: One More Try: Prologue
demos.shortDescription: Fight your way through the lands of the magical kingdom in this turn-based, roguelike deck builder game. Fight your enemies by combining powerful poker combinations, enhance their effects, endow them with new properties, find magical relics and choose new classes for your hero.

demos.name: Crawl To The Depths Demo
demos.shortDescription: Crawl to the Depths is a first-person roguelite where you adventure through destructible caverns.

demos.name: Paralives
demos.shortDescription: Paralives is a life simulation game about building homes, lives and bonds. Through both hardship and success, where will your story take you?

demos.name: Rogue Quest
demos.shortDescription: Play poker hands to deal damage. A Pair chips, a Flush crushes, a Royal Flush ends fights. Build a deck across 5 classes, stack 88 power cards, and ascend a cursed spire where every run reshuffles the odds.

demos.name: Budgie's Bug Shop
demos.shortDescription: A short incremental game about catching bugs and running a shop filled with parakeets. Upgrade equipment, purchase game-breaking abilities, and maximize the profits of your Budgie-powered empire!

demos.name: AI Agent Lover
demos.shortDescription: A terminal-style desktop game where you approve or deny AI agent proposals with ok/deny. Work through roughly 200 dev dilemmas—Git, DB, infra, and more—under a 7-second clock, chasing score and streak combos.

demos.name: Bird Game 3
demos.shortDescription: Bird Game 3 is a fun multiplayer game for 2-8 players. Dive in with your friends as ravens or eagles, battle for eggs and customize your bird!

demos.name: TooneQuest Demo
demos.shortDescription: This Demo is an all-new level of main game TooneQuest!TooneQuest is a Creature Collection game. You must explore the islands and discover the whereabouts of the Toones, fun cartoon characters bouncing, leaping and waiting for you all around the world. Once found, you must capture them by succeeding in a test of skill and timing.

demos.name: OneDay:Eastern Gardens and Wilds(Lofi)
demos.shortDescription: "One Day" is an efficiency and focus tool designed to help you quickly enter a state of flow.Upgraded to-do list, diary, Pomodoro timer, beautiful music—experience ultimate efficiency! Drawing inspiration from ancient China, wander between traditional gardens and the rustic charm of the mountains.

demos.name: Dungeon Settlers Demo
demos.shortDescription: A colony sim based dungeon crawler where you manage your expedition to build a settlement in barren land, provide food and shelter for your people, lead them deep into the merciless dungeon, overcome challenging combat by your strategy.

demos.name: BRICKFALL
demos.shortDescription: Bounce balls, collect XP, and craft unique builds. Use a variety of weapons—from lightning to homing missiles—to create chaotic synergies. Defeat bosses every 5 minutes and turn a single ball into a screen-filling barrage. How long can you survive the Infinite Mode?

demos.name: Recall Rogue
demos.shortDescription: The knowledge roguelite. Answer questions to hit harder, skip them to die faster. The deeper you go, the more the dungeon punishes ignorance. Bosses shrug off everything but proven knowledge. 98 decks, 7 languages, 67,000 real facts. Guilt-free gaming.

demos.name: World Order: Global Power
demos.shortDescription: Lead a nation, shape global policy, and rewrite history in this deep real-time grand strategy and political simulation.

demos.name: Paskahousu
demos.shortDescription: A traditional Finnish folk card game, brought to Steam. Shed your cards, nuke the pile, bluff your friends — don't be the last one holding. Full Finnish and English. Online multiplayer included.

demos.name: Virtual Driving School
demos.shortDescription: Learn to drive at home. Master real‑world road rules in bite‑size lessons, pass your driving test, then take on taxi, delivery, and bus routes across living cities and motorways. Realistic handling, dynamic weather, Left Hand/Right Hand drive, full wheel support.

demos.name: LogiGolf Demo
demos.shortDescription: LogiGolf is a relaxing golf puzzle game where you place walls to guide the ball. Journey between islands to uncover new challenges and surprising discoveries.

demos.name: 执念刑警之消失的证人
demos.shortDescription: Lu Yan has 9 days to find the truth and bring five strangers back alive. Hours of cinematic video — surveillance, dashcam, interrogations — are the evidence you study; a punishing board demands you connect 130+ clues and 70+ deductions by hand. Stuck? Spend Intuition. 6–8 hours.

demos.name: Slime in the Ice Machine Demo
demos.shortDescription: In your dying dad's strip-mall cantina, you find a psychotropic slime tunnel to the world's greatest dives. Each new bar has a surreal crisis to solve: kick open doors to places you don't belong, entangle yourself with strangers, and master practical vices such as vandalism, seduction, & journalism.

demos.name: Axiom Of Echoes: Proof Refactor Demo
Null Zone: No Way Back
demos.shortDescription: A dark sorcerer shattered the world into isolated zones and filled them with creatures bound to his will. You're here to find him and claim the bounty — but first, you must survive.

demos.name: Wanted
demos.shortDescription: Play as a Wanted cowboy in this fast-paced 8-bit arcade survival game. Face relentless waves of enemies from the Wild West and beyond!

demos.name: Blind Box Shop Simulator
demos.shortDescription: Open your own blind box store in the anime city of Akihabara. Stock the shelves with the latest blind boxes, or unbox them to collect rare hidden editions. Create a trendy blind box shop that attracts customers and expands your business.

demos.name: Voidline
demos.shortDescription: Survive relentless machine swarms in the collapsing Voidline. Loot upgrades, evolve your ship, and stack game-breaking builds as each run grows faster, harder, and more chaotic. Unlock new ships and become unstoppable.

demos.name: Dimension Rift : Otaku Save The World Demo
Arcanum Nights Demo
demos.shortDescription: This is a pixel-style puzzle game where you can enjoy new gimmicks. Light up the nights of Oenothera, Helian, and Arcanum.

demos.name: Before the screen goes black
demos.shortDescription: You only have one week to befriend the one who lives on the other side of the screen. He’s waiting for you, remembers all your visits, and even notices how long you’re gone. Play mini-games, listen to his thoughts, and simply watch how the world around you changes.

demos.name: Drop and Grow
demos.shortDescription: A short incremental clicker about growing plants by dropping water. Sit back and relax while you restore nature.

demos.name: Walk The Frog
demos.shortDescription: Guide Froggo through a world on sticky notes and relax while solving the puzzle of his journey home to find his best friend Buddy. Meet quirky animal friends, solve satisfying puzzles, help one another and relax in this cozy and heartwarming adventure with an intuitive drag-and-drop puzzle style.

demos.name: SlimeVR
demos.shortDescription: SlimeVR Server is a companion software for your SlimeVR Full-Body Trackers.

demos.name: The Longest Tale
demos.shortDescription: Uncover a forgotten legend as you venture through mythical realms. Play as four heroes bound by a mysterious fate. Explore ancient ruins, outsmart deadly foes and solve arcane puzzles. Each path you take reveals a piece of The Longest Tale.

demos.name: Mouseward Demo
demos.shortDescription: Play the opening of Mouseward and get introduced to the world of Terrene. Take up your sword and uncover the secrets of a cursed kingdom in this soulslike collectathon. Awaken as a Royal Mouse Guard, master combat, defeat foes and search for celestial fragments to restore a once great kingdom.

demos.name: The Guardian of Nature
demos.shortDescription: «The Guardian of Nature» is a hand-drawn, size-changing adventure. Embark on a magical journey with botanist Henry, use your size-changing ability to explore nature in big and small and solve solarpunk puzzles to put nature back in order.

demos.name: Cutout Village Demo
demos.shortDescription: Enjoy the calm of village life and spark your creativity in this building and crafting game inspired by cutout books.

demos.name: Paklyx
demos.shortDescription: PAKLYX is a turn-based puzzle game about finding the correct sequence of moves. Use special buttons to manipulate timers, delay them, and collect all keys in the level.

demos.name: Battle Nap Demo
demos.shortDescription: Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

demos.name: BBS (Bulletin Board System) Magica
demos.shortDescription: Magical Girl Programming ✖︎ auto-battle! An office worker is assigned to manage a fan exchange bulletin board when she was once a magical girl, Become a magical girl in cyberspace and protect the message board.

demos.name: The Recipe for Life. A Journey Through Silent Apocalypses Demo
demos.shortDescription: You are a wanderer with a cracked soul and a home on wheels. Your task is to hear the voices of those who want to take their own lives, and to find the right words before they fall silent forever.

demos.name: Coffee Talk Tokyo
demos.shortDescription: Coffee Talk Tokyo is the newest entry in the beloved series, set in a late-night café in Tokyo. Brew drinks, meet humans and yōkai, and experience heartfelt stories in a cozy, story-rich world.

demos.name: Jarred Defense Demo
demos.shortDescription: A maze-building tower defense where tower placement is everything. Force enemies the long way around, build choke points, push through lava, and adapt as levels change beneath you. No spells, no card modifiers. Just planning, placement, and a cat stuck in a jar.

demos.name: London Train!
demos.shortDescription: Run London Trains! Operate the London Underground, overground lines and National Rails!

demos.name: Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story Demo
demos.shortDescription: A story-driven productivity adventure where you work alongside Memorie, an apprentice witch from another world. As you focus using the Pomodoro timer, the story progresses and her world gradually transforms. This demo offers ~4 hours through Chapter 5 — save data carries over to the full game.

demos.name: 糺糺縁糸（きゅうきゅうえんし） Demo
Violet Mansion
demos.shortDescription: Violet Mansion is a horror puzzle game where you and your friends must survive against various enemies by using absurd items, finding creative solutions... and pushing people down stairs. Or you alone get to uncover the story of two friends who made a promise.

demos.name: Rock, Paper, Scissors: Survival
demos.shortDescription: Eight warriors from across the world. One ancient game reimagined as a fantasy battle for survival. Wield Rock, Paper, Scissors, or cast devastating Magic. Read your opponent, strike with precision, and fight your way to victory in the ultimate arena showdown.

demos.name: DeadWeight: A Lullaby Demo
demos.shortDescription: A baby fell. You jumped after it. God didn't like that. DeadWeight: A Lullaby is a psychological narrative experience about guilt, judgment, and the weight of human intent.

demos.name: Palliative - Reach for an Angel
demos.shortDescription: When youth shines brightest, every second is a tactical battle against time. Join Yuu and a close-knit group of friends in a desaturating world as they help Nana a girl facing her final days reach for a perfectly ordinary life. A story of friendship, and the courage to stay until the final whistle.

demos.name: Cosmic Run
demos.shortDescription: Cosmic Run is a single-player space roguelite where you battle relentless galactic enemies, strategically upgrade your ship, and help the Zogark family survive their journey across the galaxy. Build powerful combinations, adapt to chaotic encounters, and escape one broken system after another.

demos.name: Desktop Nard: Dice Idle
demos.shortDescription: Idle Dice roll automatically for you, unleashing skills and farming rare loot in the corner of your desktop, with tons of content and loot types.

demos.name: PeeWee Purpdrank's FOENEM Clicker
demos.shortDescription: The OFFICIAL PeeWee Purpdrank VIDEO GAME. Double Tap the FOENEM button in this wacky and hilarious idle-clicker.

demos.name: Lover's Enigma
demos.shortDescription: In Lover's Enigma , you investigate your husband's mysterious death while balancing complex relationships and personal trauma. Navigate a web of secrets involving a hidden cult and key characters. Your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

demos.name: Bloodweight
demos.shortDescription: 100 generations. one ledger. one heir at a time. you are the bloodline itself, guiding your lineage through the ages. you spend each life; the Soul Teller writes what it was. when your line ends, you read the chronicle of yourself. how will YOUR dynasty fall?

demos.name: Phonopolis
demos.shortDescription: Phonopolis is a story-driven puzzle adventure set in a hand-painted 3D world made of cardboard. Solve a wide variety of playful puzzles and help Felix end the Leader's oppressive influence in a resonant dystopian city inspired by avant-garde art.

demos.name: Clucker Clicker
demos.shortDescription: Save the family farm before the bank takes it. A cozy 2D incremental clicker about chickens, eggs, and outrunning foreclosure, one egg at a time.

demos.name: Sporbs
demos.shortDescription: A relaxing incremental game where you harvest resources from alien organisms. Upgrade your extraction technology, discover unique abilities, manage resources, automate a factory and unlock new areas to maximise your yield.

demos.name: Bouncy Weapons
demos.shortDescription: An incremental game where weapons bounce around killing enemies for you. Collect loot, master a massive skill tree, and uncover tons of content.

demos.name: Noun Town Language Learning
demos.shortDescription: Learn 1,000+ words and phrases in 12 languages - including Japanese & Spanish - with no subscription and no ads. Explore a colorful open world, beat vocab mini-games, and speak to NPCs using real speech recognition. Language learning that actually sticks, and actually feels like a game.

demos.name: Pain Pain Go Away!
demos.shortDescription: A counseling-themed typing adventure where you type away the “words of trauma” eating into girls’ hearts. The girls who visit a secret psychiatric clinic carry deep inner darkness—some repeatedly run away from home, while others believe they are murderers. Save them with your typing.

demos.name: 神祇Pantheon Demo
demos.shortDescription: Dark Matter God × unemployed girl. A two-way redemption otome visual novel.

demos.name: Lucky Shot Demo
demos.shortDescription: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky shot is a roguelike deckbuilder FPS where you master different weapons, discover unique combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

demos.name: Qiú 泅
demos.shortDescription: A rescue robot had lost all teammates in a tsunami. Experience the emotional struggle and empathy in the post-apocalyptic world of Qiú, where, through a series of side-scrolling puzzle games, you help the robot achieve its dream, even at the cost of death.

demos.name: The Hidden Evils Club Demo
demos.shortDescription: Try the first defense missions of Weird Hill and survive against escalating zombie waves. Build towers, manage resources, meet survivors, and face the growing threat hidden beneath the town.Demo IncludesDefend the first district of Weird HillBuild and upgrade defensive towersManage resources and town suppliesMeet survivor NPCs and trade...

demos.name: Idle AI Factory Demo
demos.shortDescription: Dive into the world of machine learning! Idle AI Architecture is a node-based automation incremental game where you harvest resources and train neural networks. Manage your economy, optimize your grid, and automate your way to a multi-million dollar tech empire.

demos.name: Orca Insurgency Demo
demos.shortDescription: Play as an orca in a fast-paced ocean rebellion against yachts, whalers, and human greed. Smash boats, rescue your pod, command other orcas, hunt with echolocation, and test absurd weapons from a mysterious octopus arms dealer. The Orca Insurgency begins.

demos.name: 探偵Rと預言者J Demo
demos.shortDescription: Gather evidence and uncover the truth through your interactions with others in this mystery adventure game about a case where past and present collide.

demos.name: Shape Together
demos.shortDescription: Shape Together is a factory-building game: lay mines, belts, and machines, automate shapes, and use them to defeat monsters and bosses. Hold back waves, grow stronger over time—solo or with friends on Steam.

demos.name: Trees Inc
demos.shortDescription: Build a self-sustaining forest in this incremental idle game where you chop trees, automate production with workers, stack upgrades for exponential growth, and use prestige and XP-based perks to push your output further every run.

demos.name: Tokyo Re:Connect Demo
demos.shortDescription: Spring is the season of first meetings. Begin your new life in the city of Tokyo as Shindou Touki. Meet many colorful characters, forge romances, and live out your high-school days, in this interactive story with cutting-edge artwork and a moving soundtrack.

demos.name: One Last Hand Demo
demos.shortDescription: Build the perfect hand. SLAP YOUR FRIENDS with it. A chaotic party game where secret bids decide the cards, unfair Relics ruin the rules, and the biggest ego at the table usually cracks first.

demos.name: Typegrinder
demos.shortDescription: A keyboard-first typing game built around discovery. Hunt new words across 3-to-12 letter brackets, forge speed-runs from your personal decks, and battle the world on daily online leaderboards. Pure typing, no fluff.

demos.name: Thrifty Business
demos.shortDescription: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

demos.name: Tethyscope
demos.shortDescription: Explore our planet's ocean to discover animals, plants, and shipwrecks. Take photographs to document your findings and sell them to fund upgrades to your submarine.

demos.name: Big Bad Soccer
demos.shortDescription: Fast-paced arcade football where skill and physics decide everything. Control a massive ball, build and steal Super Hits, and score fast — no stats, no fouls, no upgrades.

demos.name: Flounder Demo
demos.shortDescription: The Ocean Ecosystem Roguelite. Grow a colorful school of fish with unique abilities and unlock powerful items to help them repel boss invasions. Collect rare fish to complete your peaceful Virtual Tank. Hold the line and surface victorious! The depth is deceiving.

demos.name: PredaDeck Demo
demos.shortDescription: PredaDeck is a trading card game that transforms the brutal yet exquisite real-world food chain into a competitive strategic duel. Here, knowledge is your sharpest claw, and strategy is your only law of survival.

demos.name: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey Demo
Triangles
demos.shortDescription: Music freed from the timeline. Place triangles, launch balls, and build your own soundscape.

demos.name: Battle Boss Demo
demos.shortDescription: Manage your very own battlemon gym! In this demo, experience a few days in the life of a Battle Boss, where it's your job to battle challengers and manage your gym!

demos.name: The Ultra Realistic Accurate Farmer Simulator
demos.shortDescription: Ultra-short and dramatic satirical visual novel about the hardships and challenges of farming life

demos.name: MONSTOPIA Demo
demos.shortDescription: A demon raised by humans, a run-down amusement park, and a renaissance of scare art. You will play as an ambitious young demon, determined to transform the dilapidated park into the most thrilling horror-themed attraction.

demos.name: 命运之轮（序章）/Journey of Destiny(dependent origination) Demo
demos.shortDescription: A Chinese ancient-style visual novel made with Ren'Py. Two factions fight for a mysterious relic. Your choices unlock multiple endings. The story includes suspense, time travel and soul fusion. Simple mouse and keyboard controls. Enjoy an immersive storytelling experience.

demos.name: Die Deep Demo
demos.shortDescription: Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies. No exploration, no puzzles, The only core is Combat. One reckless move or greedy strike, and it’s all over. Answer the silent call of the abyss. Descend into the depths to find your forgotten desires.

demos.name: Pinball Tide
demos.shortDescription: Pinball Tide is an ocean-themed roguelike pinball game. Control the flippers to score points and strategically earn gold. Use points to enhance your gameplay, and spend gold to draw higher-rarity balls and merge them. Through merging, you can discover new flippers and balls.

demos.name: Mr Right Simulator
demos.shortDescription: A youth to his student era,, 、awakening a Temporal Love System. With wingman Tong Jincheng, he navigates campus innocence and corporate battles using future intel. Bonds with 7 girls across timelines—witness you from bike to AMG. Can spacetime's equation balance love and ambition?

demos.name: Sellin' Snake Oil
demos.shortDescription: Buy low, sell high, and survive the frontier. Sellin' Snake Oil is a western trading roguelike where every run brings a new map, new prices, new challenges, and new decisions. The ranch won't buy itself.

demos.name: Zenith Expanse Demo
demos.shortDescription: Play the opening hour of a living space colony survival sim. Wake your crew, secure water and food, build your first fragile settlements, and survive 50 Sols on a compact 30-star map.

demos.name: Minesweeper: Unlimited Expansion
demos.shortDescription: Classic Minesweeper but infinite scaling

demos.name: SiNiSistar 2
demos.shortDescription: Step into a beautifully somber pixel art world of decay filled with grotesque, writhing abominations...A dark action RPG that follows the journey of a demon-slaying nun who must resist destruction and despair while purging the corruption from this world one boss after another!

demos.name: The Melty Way
demos.shortDescription: You move, you melt. You are a liquid-simulated slime where every move costs you a piece of yourself. Spend your mass to slide, shrink, and dash through pixel-perfect hazards in this challenging precision platformer where size management is critical and your only resource is your own body.

demos.name: Manaclysm Demo
demos.shortDescription: Manaclysm is a PvP brawler where up to 60 mages wage war across realms fractured by magic. Slay enemy mages to upgrade your mana and spell arsenal. Invite friends to a private game, or hop into ranked matchmaking for some massive brawls! This demo has full online multiplayer limited to 8 players.

demos.name: Neuron Connection
demos.shortDescription: Step into a microscopic world where neurons float and pulse. Connect synapses, guide neurotransmitters, and shape the flow of the network. Watch neurotransmitters travel along the paths, circuits light up, and the neural world softly hum to life under your connections.

demos.name: Skigill
demos.shortDescription: Fight! Collect! Explore! Experiment! Survive! Master the SKIGILL, a large skill tree spanning the entire battleground, to power your character and survive waves of enemies. Unlock upgrades, weapons, and characters in a meta sigil after each game, and maybe you'll see the end!

demos.name: SHULERO – Dice Roguelike Demo
demos.shortDescription: Yacht-inspired roguelike (Poker Dice). Roll dice. Build combos. Beat bosses. Cheat to win.

demos.name: The Forgotten Nightmare Series
demos.shortDescription: A classic-style text adventure game spanning three chapters. Enter verb/noun commands via keyboard, mouse, or game controller to explore, collect items, and solve puzzles in a post-apocalyptic, Christian-themed story. Features an auto-drawing map and hint system.

demos.name: Durak Online by Pokerist
demos.shortDescription: Play the best Durak Online game with real players for free! Invite friends, choose your game mode, and enjoy fantastic graphics on any device.

demos.name: Down with the Ship
demos.shortDescription: Strategic auto battler where you design a heavily-armed spaceship. Draft 200+ items, outfit your hull, and unleash it in async PvP. Blend captains and factions for absurd combos and galactic domination. Roll, buy, place, pray.

demos.name: Dungeons of Freeport
demos.shortDescription: A Daily Extraction Roguelike Dungeon-Crawler. Play the same dungeons as everyone else, once a day. Select your gear and delve into dungeons, attempting to escape with the loot you obtain. Inspired by classical roguelikes of decades past, but with a modern interface and metagame.

demos.name: Pieces of the Kingdom Demo
demos.shortDescription: What if Chess…was a roguelite? Assemble your party and battle your way across a broken kingdom in a fantastical, tactical take on Chess. Loot epic gear, recruit powerful pieces with unique abilities, and strategize your way to victory. This DEMO contains only the first campaign + skirmish mode.

demos.name: Dream Adventurer
demos.shortDescription: "Dream Adventurer" is a free adventure game where players battle, explore, and search for treasure chests within a dreamlike realm.

demos.name: Severed Light
demos.shortDescription: SEVERED LIGHT is an ARPG where you slay demons, Battle epic bosses, then go fishing and find the perfect spot for your house plant. Loot, explore, quest, kill and chill... in no specific order.

demos.name: That's An Order Ensign
demos.shortDescription: Complete a slew of mundane and dangerous tasks, Do it quick or you're dismissed! Try to stay alive, but do your job.  Because after all... That's an order, ensign!

demos.name: Before Closure
demos.shortDescription: An experimental narrative game that tells its story through sound and memory. Sort through a box of personal mementos and relive memories from a relationship by closing your eyes in real life.

demos.name: Skrrt Racing
demos.shortDescription: Race through stylized old school arcade levels, unlock JDM inspired cars and upgrade performance parts, visual evolution and customization. Beat bosses, evolve your build, and push into infinite mode in this fully offline 2D racing game.

demos.name: Catjong 5: Paw Canyon
demos.shortDescription: Embark on a cozy mahjong-3 adventure with your playful cat! Solve 200 fun levels and build a charming Wild West town in a warm, sunlit canyon.

demos.name: Bible Quiz: Trivia Game
demos.shortDescription: Race the clock across hundreds of Bible trivia questions! Test your knowledge of scripture, famous figures, miracles, parables, and more. Perfect for faith communities, trivia fans, and anyone curious about the world's most read book.

demos.name: The Fourth Sense Evolution: Stone Age Demo
demos.shortDescription: A top-down 2D evolution and survival sandbox where you play as a god guiding the Jilongs through a chosen one, miracles, and karma.

demos.name: Koumii
demos.shortDescription: Enter a magical duel where every turn is a new creation. Craft your own spells, predict your opponent's moves, and outplay them in a fast-paced battle to be the last player standing. A casual 2-player experience for friends and foes alike.

demos.name: Tavern Timer
demos.shortDescription: Welcome to your Tavern! A cozy focus tool where you pick a keeper to run the tavern while you work. Customize from floor to fireplace with 200+ items. Pomodoro, custom timers, and to-do list included. Productivity has never felt so magical!

demos.name: Move, Move, Melon!!
demos.shortDescription: You’re Melon, a tiny hamster with a huge goal. Collect mix-ins, roll fast, and build momentum to churn the biggest ice cream scoop ever in this whimsical, on-rails runner.

demos.name: Weapon Gambit Demo
demos.shortDescription: Roll your weapons, plan your every move! A bite-sized tactical puzzle blending dice and chess. Strategize your positioning with the rolled weapons to dismantle enemy defenses. Strike directly at the Monster Crystal before your turns run out!

demos.name: sportive
demos.shortDescription: Sportive is a online deck building card game with a sports theme. You compete against a Bot or other players, building up your playbook, gaining points, and redeeming them for trophies. The person with the most trophies at the end of the game wins.

demos.name: Let Me Play!
demos.shortDescription: After shouting "Let Me Play!" to the cast in a theatre, the fiction comes crashing down as everyone, including you, becomes aware they're only following a script. Will you let the play continue? Or will you write your own ending?

demos.name: Nerdy Quest
demos.shortDescription: A nostalgic 1980s-inspired point-and-click adventure packed with puzzles, quirky humor, and bizarre pop-culture references. Explore cinematic environments, talk to eccentric characters, collect and combine items — and discover a surprising burst of action at the end.

demos.name: Klifur
demos.shortDescription: Minimalist 2D bouldering. Make your way through over 30 hand-made campaign routes or use the level editor to make your own routes and share them with friends!

demos.name: Wizard Confidential
demos.shortDescription: Sling spells and crack the case in a city full of bootleggers, corrupt cops, and vampires. Can you save your partner before a wizard dooms Seattle? A text-based interactive urban fantasy noir novel.

demos.name: OurLife
demos.shortDescription: OurLife is a text-forward life simulator game filled with immersive, choice-driven systems that impact more than just the character you're playing. Live any life, make any choice: OurLife.

demos.name: Cozy Mining Demo
demos.shortDescription: A cozy idle mining game that lives on your desktop. Click to send your miner digging. They'll walk, dig, and collect automatically while you work or relax. Forge pickaxes, equip accessories, unlock adorable animal miners, and grow stronger with every run. Reach Floor 1000 — together. ⛏️✨

demos.name: Swing Dynasty: College Tennis
demos.shortDescription: An unrivaled college tennis video game. Play as a Men’s or Women’s Tennis coach, take control of a team, recruit players, develop your roster, and compete for national championships. Build a college tennis dynasty and become a legend!

demos.name: Momo Don't Leave Demo
demos.shortDescription: Short demo of Momo Don’t Leave, focused on atmosphere and memory... Return to a town that never changed, and encounter someone who was never supposed to be there.

demos.name: Orebits Demo
demos.shortDescription: Bounce your pickaxe and smash through asteroids in this futuristic mining incremental! Explore a roguelite tech tree, discover gravitational anomalies, and deliver resources back to Earth. Upgrade and explore space to discover what secrets it holds!

demos.name: Master Healer Kale with useless party Demo
Janggi
demos.shortDescription: Janggi - Korean Chess

demos.name: HEXA
demos.shortDescription: Board the helm of Starship HEXA, and conquer the universe the only way you know how: shapes. HEXA is a unique, quick to pick up, and super fun logic puzzle game based on everybody’s favorite polygon.

demos.name: Looter Survivors Demo
demos.shortDescription: Looter Survivors blends survivors-like combat with hack-and-slash loot. Build around randomized gear effects, summon a massive army beside your hero, and fight horde against horde in a compact roguelite designed to be cleared in about 10 hours by focused players.

demos.name: Space Haven
demos.shortDescription: Embark on a space voyage with your ragtag crew of civilians in search of a new home. Build spaceships tile by tile, create optimal gas conditions, manage the needs and moods of their crew, encounter other space-faring groups, and explore the universe in this spaceship colony simulation.

demos.name: No Wings Required Demo
demos.shortDescription: Start your first day at work as an unqualified duck with a balloon and way too much confidence. Wander the Featherfall Islands, help quirky locals, and learn that “winging it” might actually be a real career strategy.

demos.name: Delegatory Demo
demos.shortDescription: A short incremental game about climbing the ranks within a dystopian retro-future corporation. Delegate tasks to your increasingly underpaid team of interns. Leverage a large branching skill tree to upgrade your team's efficiencies, and unlock unique powers.

demos.name: Okinawa Soba Simulator
demos.shortDescription: A 3D simulation game where you run an Okinawa soba shop by yourself, handling orders, cooking, serving, and payments efficiently.

demos.name: CaseCracker3
demos.shortDescription: Confronted with fragmented narratives and deceptive persons of interest, you must isolate crucial evidence. Shatter logical loopholes from testimonies and reconstruct the crime scene from subtle clues. Can you survive this immersive battle of wits?

demos.name: ARIE: Moonprayer
demos.shortDescription: ARIE: Moonprayer is a beautiful, short 3D anime exploration experience through an ending world, where melodies weave through your final journey on earth.

demos.name: Heroes of Artadis
demos.shortDescription: Choose a faction, build a deck, and participate in incredible turn-based PVP battles across the realms of Artadis!

demos.name: XFlight: FPV Drone Simulator
demos.shortDescription: A top-notch FPV simulator with excellent control feel and a wealth of engaging content.

demos.name: Stitchlings
demos.shortDescription: Grab a friend and embark on a bite-sized co-op combat adventure fighting toy monsters, picking them apart, while you stitch together your uniquely customized Stitchlings!

demos.name: ClassBoom
demos.shortDescription: This is a physics-based casual sandbox game, where there are no limits to your creativity. Mess around with liquids, explore the space, build machines, or just explode everything you can see.

demos.name: A.K.O - Arrow Keys Only
demos.shortDescription: One hand. Four arrow keys. Your weapon auto-fires while you dodge, climb, and swap elements to survive. 5 pilots, 75 skins, 35+ relics, 10 trials. A tiny roguelike shooter built around a beautiful bad idea.

demos.name: Flat 207
demos.shortDescription: A surrealist exploration of the mind of a man trapped in a room. Part game, part short film, part disaster, Flat 207 is a cursed video game with no traditional game mechanics that takes roughly 40 minutes to finish.

demos.name: Dissolution of the Silent Union Demo
Witch Pachi Demo
demos.shortDescription: Aim, shoot, and gather mana! Witch Pachi is a unique hybrid of physics-based pinball action and turn-based roguelike strategy. Build your deck of powerful spells, form mystical pacts, and master the board to defeat your enemies in this magical adventure.

demos.name: Breath Bound
demos.shortDescription: Breath Bound is a 2D co-op puzzle adventure where two divers share one oxygen tank and have to keep each other alive by scrounging air and navigating the treacherous obstacles of the sea. Every stretch of the journey back to the surface is a small test of coordination, timing and teamwork.

demos.name: Forgotten Records
demos.shortDescription: What would you do if you were stuck in an ancient shrine filled with creatures unknown to reality? Forgotten Records is a romance visual novel set in the modern world, where the protagonist wanders into the wrong shrine at the wrong time and has to escape.

demos.name: Uncle Lee’s Cookbook: Five Recipes for Disaster
demos.shortDescription: Uncle Lee has done it again. It’s up to you to pick up the pieces. Join rebellious teen Ines as she deals with the fallout of her uncle Lee’s experiments/inventions/cooking, in a modern point & click adventure in five self-contained episodes.

demos.name: Shadow Solitaire
demos.shortDescription: Shadow Solitaire is a roguelite, turn-based score-chasing card strategy game where you chain plays across multiple lanes, build powerful skill synergies, and manage risk through shop upgrades, casino bets, bank loans, and market trading.

demos.name: Minute Mark
demos.shortDescription: Minute Mark is a 2D singleplayer platformer where you run, jump, and slide across hand-drawn levels at incredible speed, racing against a strict timer. Rewind your mistakes and make creative skips to chase the leaderboard.

demos.name: Elfie: A Sand Plan
demos.shortDescription: Elfie: A Sand Plan is a relaxing and intuitive puzzle game where you help a small ambitious elephant build some sand castles. Enjoy spending time at the beach with your new rotund friend!

demos.name: The Serpent & The Seed Demo
demos.shortDescription: Explore the Garden of Eden in Act I of a sweeping poetic adventure retelling the greatest story in history through stunning art, immersive music, and atmospheric puzzles.

demos.name: Tennis Manager 26
demos.shortDescription: Step into the most advanced tennis management experience ever. Run your academy, develop top talent, upgrade your staff and facilities, and dominate the junior and pro circuits. A new chapter begins, are you ready to take control?

demos.name: PROMulti-TableTournament
demos.shortDescription: PROMulti-TableTournament is a Texas Hold’em multi-table tournament strategy simulator. read hands by position, stack depth, blinds, and opponent actions, then choose fold, call, raise, or all-in to practice MTT pacing. GTOrange judgment, stack control, and final table decisions.

demos.name: Battle Match: Samurai Wars
demos.shortDescription: Command thousands of individually-simulated samurai in tactical real-time battles. Free sandbox mode. Online multiplayer.

demos.name: Port Trader
demos.shortDescription: Incremental game about trading goods between ports. Buy and sell to earn profit. Upgrade ships, increase port capacity, optimize production rate, hire new captains, automate your trading and grow your merchant empire.

demos.name: Duriano
demos.shortDescription: Duriano is a top-down arena roguelite game where the player will be a hero durian of the Norse wielding a weapon to fight upon a god of Norse mythology. From different weapons, Durian hero, God’s trail, items will lead the player to create a build and defeat the giant of fire.

demos.name: Chill & Reel
demos.shortDescription: A cozy idle fishing game where you play as an adorable alligator angler. Designed to run in the corner of your screen, it's the perfect companion for work or study—featuring rich animations that make every moment feel like watching a charming short film.

demos.name: Hamster Ballers Demo
demos.shortDescription: A friendship-ending, physics-based, ragebait game where you play as hamsters trapped inside a hamster ball and you can't get out until you complete this stupid obstacle course.

demos.name: Necromancer's Army Demo
demos.shortDescription: A dark narrative idle game where your clicks fuel a ritual that begins to answer back. This free demo runs the full Act 1 arc plus a taste of Act 2. 30 to 60 minutes. Wishlist for the full five-act story and three endings.

demos.name: The Last Winter Knight
demos.shortDescription: Haunt a suit of armour. Explore an abandoned castle. Recover your memories... and bring the ghosts of the past to rest in this melancholy visual novel about love, family and regret.

demos.name: Super Night Riders S1
demos.shortDescription: Super Night Riders S1 is a modern checkpoint arcade racer inspired by '80s classics. Race as Alice, the Red Rider, across 12 stages from day to sunrise. Dodge rivals and beat the clock - distance matters more than position.

demos.name: Greenhearth Necromancer
demos.shortDescription: Raise a garden... from the dead! Greenhearth Necromancer is a cozy, witchy, semi-idle game about caring for living and undead plants alike. Grow cute plants in your balcony garden, cast spells, and brew potions, enjoying the chill idle gameplay and ambience throughout your day.

demos.name: Drifting Dots
demos.shortDescription: A minimalist physics roguelite where you create a mesmerizing cascade of droplets. Choose from three distinct modes and discover powerful upgrade synergies to master the flow. Calm, complex, and endlessly replayable.

demos.name: Project Looking Glass Demo
demos.shortDescription: 1963. A classified CIA experiment. A grieving mother. A signal that won't stop transmitting. Step through the Looking Glass — a first-person psychological horror told through the static of a Cold War-era apparatus that peers into places mankind was never meant to reach.

demos.name: argmax Loop
demos.shortDescription: die listening to techno bangers.

demos.name: NOOK FALL: West Town
demos.shortDescription: A charming yet fantastical town, where vitality and decay constantly collide. We hope that through interactions with characters and objects, and the sensory experience created by visuals and sound, you can connect with the emotions and charm of this little world of West Town.

demos.name: Cliff Kingdom Demo
demos.shortDescription: The lighthouse has gone dark! You awake as Mothboy, last in a long line of lightkeepers summoned when something goes wrong. In this action packed adventure you climb, fight and explore the depths of Cliff Kingdom searching for the lost light.

demos.name: Descension
demos.shortDescription: Descend into the Alternate Realm to save your lost friend and face The Ultimate Entity. Customize your party, master unique Soul Shards, and grow stronger—physically, mentally, and emotionally—in this stat-driven sandbox RPG.

demos.name: The Siege of Jeomdo
demos.shortDescription: Hope flickers against impossible odds. In this narrative RPG, step into the shoes of a retired soldier, thrust into a desperate last stand to save Jeomdo Village. With supplies dwindling and time running out, your decisions will shape the fate of those who look to you for salvation.

demos.name: Retro Manager
demos.shortDescription: A fast-paced retro football management game inspired by the 90s. Build your squad, tweak tactics, and watch matches unfold minute-by-minute.

demos.name: Order of the Ivy
demos.shortDescription: A new modern, turn-based pixel RPG by Rust Games! Silly tone, serious quest. Set in a dystopian America, the party must overthrow evil feudal lords called the Quorum while managing Kyle's worst impulses.

demos.name: S-mail
demos.shortDescription: After the death of your lover May, you suddenly receive a new email: she is back, in the form of AI "M". The lover who "lives" in the mailbox, who is strong and eternal, always online, and always loves you. You just need to send letters to her: your choices will affect her and the story.

demos.name: Wordban: a text-based Sokoban game
demos.shortDescription: Wordban is a word-based sokoban game, where a special transformation block defines the cornerstone of how all things operate. Control "Wordo" to push blocks, change the rules of the level, and read Wordo's diary!

demos.name: Lenos
demos.shortDescription: Loot, shoot, and survive the depths with friends. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, gear up with powerful weapons and perks, and fight your way to extraction in this top-down co-op dungeon crawler.

demos.name: Rollick N' Roll
demos.shortDescription: Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Explore a collection of marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist.
